intro: Male and female students are admitted either as boarders or day scholars. Admission to any of the courses is open throughout the calendar year.
bursary: Primary 7 leavers with an aggregate between 4 and 28 points are admitted on Government bursary between January and February of each year as day scholars.
how_to_apply: Visit the campus at Iganga Town, Kaliro Road, Nkono 1 zone, or call the Director or Dean of Students to enquire.
Choose a full-time (2–3 year) or short-time (1/3/6/9 month) course from the course list.
Complete registration at the campus — bring any prior academic documents you have.
Government bursary applicants (P7 leavers, aggregate 4–28) should apply between January and February.
